lens_description: Buildings stand out on the aerial imagery: outlined and filled in red, the type in its own colour, the number of dwellings as a coloured outline and a label. After the building styles of the kaligrafy iD fork.
lens_note: The number of dwellings (building:flats, flats or houses) wins over the type: from 1 in cyan to 8 in orange, above in red, with the number on the building from zoom 17. Areas are filled at 30 % so the imagery shows through.
